text:
Anya R: Heads-up: I pushed a catalog entry for calypso-3b-lite and want to pin it as v2.3 for internal beta tomorrow. Planning a light rollout at 10:30am PST (canary -> 10% -> 100% if green). Who can own deploy + smoke checks and be ready to rollback?

Mike L: I can own the deploy step and watch the canary. Will need someone to run smoke and monitor token-level latency during the window.

Rajesh P: I can do the smoke checks and quick quality sampling. Can you paste the smoke curl and the expected perf numbers?

Anya R: Thanks — smoke command is below. Expected baseline: p50 <= 120ms, p95 <= 300ms for 32-token inference on our dedicated pool. If p95 exceeds 400ms or error rate > 0.5% we abort and rollback.
```bash
# smoke against staging-canary route
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-internal/staging/generate \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"calypso-3b-lite","input":"Summarize: The quick brown fox"}'
```

Toni K: FYI infra reserved the slot and pinned GPU pool A -> calypso-3b-lite v2.3 for the canary. I set autoscale min=2, max=8 for the window. Will enable KV cache warmup 15m prior.

deploy-bot: deployment-window: reserved by mike at 2026-03-18T10:30:00-08:00 for calypso-3b-lite:v2.3; env=staging-canary

Mike L: I'll kick the rollout at 10:30. Plan: deploy canary (10%), wait 10m, run smoke script, if green -> 10%->50% after 15m, then 100% after another 20m. If rollback: pin previous model (calypso-3b:v2.2) back and drain canary.

Sarah M: I'll monitor Console dashboards and set up a quick eval set in the background to run against a sample of generated outputs (5 prompts). Will post a summary in this thread.

Rajesh P: I'll run smoke and post results here. Quick reminder — include a small sample-based eval for hallucination rate (simple QA pairs). If > 3% we abort.

Anya R: Permissions/handshake: @Mike L please ensure you have the rollout flag in the console and tag the run with "calypso-beta". @Toni K confirm rollback playbook path /ops/rollbacks/calypso exists.

Toni K: Confirmed. Rollback playbook present, pretested last week. I'll be on standby 10:15-11:30 PST.

Mike L: Got the flag. I'll add the tag.

Rajesh P: Smoke results: all 5 prompts returned in p50=95ms p95=230ms, error rate=0.0%, hallucination sample 1/50 (2%). Reporting green.

Sarah M: Console: token cost looks as expected, slight uptick in tail but within threshold. Eval samples: quality comparable to v2.2 for short QA, slight verbosity increase flagged. Recommend watchful rollout but proceed.

Anya R: Nice — proceeding with 10% -> 50% per plan. If anyone sees latency spikes or >0.5% errors, post here and we flip the rollback. Otherwise I'll file the catalog release note after 100% completes. :party_parrot:

Mike L: Starting 10% now. Will update at each step.

deploy-bot: rollout-stage: canary (10%) started by Mike L at 2026-03-18T10:30:05-08:00

Mike L: 10% steady for 12m, moving to 50% now. No errors observed.

Rajesh P: Re-running quick smoke at 50%: p50=100ms p95=260ms error rate=0.1% hallucination 1/50. Still within thresholds.

Sarah M: Dashboards steady, no customer-facing errors.

Mike L: 100% now. Tagging thread with final rollout id: rollout/calypso-v2.3-2039876543

Anya R: Thanks all — putting follow-up tasks in the release checklist (docs, changelog). If someone wants to do a deeper eval tomorrow, please volunteer.

Toni K: I'll schedule a postmortem-lite next week to review perf tail and any tuning opportunities.

Mike L: LGTM :thumbsup:

Rajesh P: Nice and clean.

Sarah M: Will post the 24h perf snapshot in #eng-ml.

Anya R: Closing thread once release note is posted. Great job everyone.
